Definition: from G5242; prominence, i.e. (figuratively) superiority (in rank or character):--authority, excellency.
BiblicalUsage: In the New Testament, hyperochḗ is the word for prominence, superiority, authority. In 1 Corinthians 2:1, the text says "came not with excellency of speech or of wisdom."
TheologicalSignificance: I read hyperochḗ plainly — it means prominence, superiority, authority, and I do not build a doctrine on it.
